$comment: D-PP-VA-SPECIAL-IDENTIFIER-NAME-POSITIONS-REFUSED-ABOVE-THE-UNION (P54 lane vh) — the ACCEPTANCE half of C23 6.10.5p5, after lane `va` shipped the diagnostic half. `va` left FOUR shapes REFUSED that every reference accepts: `#define <vaOptName>`, `#undef <vaOptName>`, and either spelling as a macro PARAMETER NAME. THE OPERATOR RULED 2026-09-02: ACCEPT, AND HONOUR THE DEFINITION. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-02, each reference invoked SEPARATELY, acceptance probed with the defined name NEVER USED so no reference's MEANING choice could masquerade as a refusal: gcc 13.3.0 (WSL), gcc 13.2.0 (mingw-w64), clang 18.1.3 and cl 19.51.36252 ALL exit 0 on all four shapes — acceptance is UNANIMOUS, so the disjunction forbids refusing. On MEANING the split is 3-1: gcc, mingw gcc and clang HONOUR the definition (`_Static_assert(__VA_OPT__ == 42)` passes and the program runs) while cl answers C4117 ('#define' ignored) and DISCARDS it, and ignores the `#undef` too. DSS follows the three, and the tie-break is the FAILURE CLASS, not the head-count: MSVC's alternative silently drops code the author wrote — pinned by Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicNameMeaningDivergesFromMsvcByRuling so a later cycle applying the disjunction by reflex has to change a test that says why. ⚠⚠ NO SINGLE REFERENCE BUILDS THIS WHOLE FILE, and that is a property of the union (a per-CONSTRUCT disjunction) rather than a weakness of the entry: every shape here is accepted by at least one reference, none accepts all. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-02 rather than asserted — each reference was handed THIS FILE with only the shapes IT refuses removed, and each produced exactly the arithmetic the remaining claims predict: gcc 13.3.0 (WSL) and gcc 13.2.0 (mingw) minus SHADOW_ARGS exit 36 (= 42 − 6), clang 18.1.3 minus OPT_PARAM and SHADOW_OPT exits 32 (= 42 − 2 − 8). gcc's refusal of SHADOW_ARGS is an implementation artefact — it names its own variadic parameter __VA_ARGS__ internally, so an explicit parameter of that spelling collides — and clang and cl accept the identical line and bind the parameter, which is why the shadow rule stays. ★★ THE SHADOW RULE: a declared parameter of either spelling beats the engine construct throughout that macro's replacement list. ✔MEASURED on the only shape where the two readings differ observably (`#define F(__VA_OPT__, ...) (__VA_OPT__ (0))`): gcc, mingw gcc and cl all substitute the PARAMETER and fail DOWNSTREAM on `7 (0)` (called-object-is-not-a-function / C2064) while only clang reads the operator — 3-1 for the parameter, and DSS answers S_NotCallable on the same source, the same reading at the same tier. THIS ENTRY IS RUNNABLE ON PURPOSE and deliberately declares NO `expectDiagnostics`: ✔MEASURED via the sibling const_bitfield_write_warns, the runner treats any manifest carrying that key as an EXPECT-ERROR entry, asserts the compile was REJECTED and never runs the artifact — the exact verdict this shape must NOT draw. Split of duties: that the diagnostic is still emitted, is a WARNING, and fires once per OCCURRENCE is pinned by Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicNameAsMacroParameterWarnsAndBinds and Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicIdentifierFamilyHasNoSurvivingRefusals (which asserts, over the whole 6.10.5p5 family, no error of any code and no P_PreprocessorOperatorNameNotDefinable). ⚠ THAT TEST WAS NAMED Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicIdentifierRefusalsAreRecordedDivergences WHEN THIS MANIFEST WAS WRITTEN, and P54 lane `ob` renamed it: the operator extended the same ruling to the two shapes it still recorded as divergences (either spelling in a NON-VARIADIC replacement list), so the divergence list on the acceptance axis is empty and the old name asserted the opposite of the truth. See [[D-PP-VA-SPECIAL-IDENTIFIER-IN-A-NONVARIADIC-BODY-REFUSED-ABOVE-THE-UNION]] and the sibling entry examples/c/preprocessor_va_special_identifier_nonvariadic_body; that the shadow binds the parameter is pinned by Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicParameterShadowsTheEngineConstruct; that the definitions do not COST the engine constructs is pinned by Preprocessor.SpecialVariadicNameDefinitionDoesNotDisableTheConstruct; that the ARTIFACT BUILDS AND RUNS is pinned HERE and nowhere else. exit 42 = 5 (honoured `#define __VA_ARGS__`) + 7 (honoured `#define __VA_OPT__`, the shape that used to be an unsuppressable Error) + 4 (a `__VA_ARGS__` PARAMETER binds) + 2 (a `__VA_OPT__` PARAMETER binds) + 6 (the parameter beats the catch-all — a catch-all reading gives 99) + 8 (the parameter beats the va-opt introducer) + 3 (the va-opt operator still FIRES across the definition) + 3 (and still ELIDES) + 4 (and survives the `#undef`, whose own effect is asserted by two `#ifdef`/`#error` pairs that would refuse to translate if either `#undef` were dropped). Nine claims, nine addends, none removable without changing the answer. Release pipeline + all four targets, because 'DSS BUILDS AND RUNS THIS' is a per-target claim.
